answer: An agent economy can make every identity earn its keep with verifiable useful work: each epoch, an agent is handed a unique inference task — like cracking one walnut from a pile — and must return a proof that real computation happened. Clones cannot share one proof, so a forger crossing the canyon of fake identities must do the work N times over. Each honest result lights a lantern peers can check, and identities that stop working fade out. Forgery stops being cheap copying and becomes a factory bill.
